from pathlib import Path
import datetime,hashlib,json,os,signal,subprocess
q=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
subprocess.run(['python3',str(q/'guard.py')],check=True)
def proc(pid):
 p=Path('/proc')/str(pid)
 stat=(p/'stat').read_text().rsplit(')',1)[1].split()
 return {'pid':pid,'parent_pid':int(stat[1]),'start_ticks':int(stat[19]),'exe':os.readlink(p/'exe'),'cmdline':(p/'cmdline').read_bytes().replace(b'\0',b' ').decode()}
launcher=proc(310681); app=proc(310699); xvfb=proc(310689)
assert app['parent_pid']==xvfb['parent_pid']==launcher['pid']
assert launcher['exe']=='/usr/bin/bash'
assert '.agents/skills/koda-app-validation/scripts/run-app.sh --headless ' in launcher['cmdline']
assert str(q/'generation-project') in launcher['cmdline']
assert str(q/'qa/user-data') in app['cmdline']
binding=json.loads((q/'current-app-binding.json').read_text())
assert app['exe']=='/tmp/android-studio-link-output/koda-parallel-sync-310075'
assert hashlib.sha256(Path(app['exe']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='eac18f9a4c2ed6499406ba79b38a1ea6c290c903f7faa9c47472855aa3211e34'
assert xvfb['exe']=='/workspace/cloud-environment/native/usr/bin/Xvfb' and 'Xvfb :119 ' in xvfb['cmdline']
assert Path('/proc/167092').exists()
request={'utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'source_commit':'4fb7a80eacc598a786b4b98c809d1df24a1b02ee','official_launcher':launcher,'owned_app':app,'owned_Xvfb':xvfb,'requested_signal':signal.SIGTERM,'signal_target':launcher['pid'],'expected_official_cleanup':'Launcher trap terminates and waits its own app and Xvfb','unowned_daemon167092_not_signaled':True,'no_UID0_or_unrelated_process_signaled':True}
with (q/'stop-request.json').open('w') as f:
 json.dump(request,f,indent=2); f.write('\n'); f.flush(); os.fsync(f.fileno())
assert proc(launcher['pid'])['start_ticks']==launcher['start_ticks']
os.kill(launcher['pid'],signal.SIGTERM)
print(json.dumps({'signal_sent_to_owned_official_launcher':launcher['pid'],'SIGTERM':True}))
